note: The column holds the all-in coupon. In '#%' the number equals the tagged interest_rate on all 543 rows. In '#% (incl. #% PIK)' n1 equals interest_rate and n2 equals pik_rate. In '#% PIK' the number equals pik_rate; the cell is a fully PIK rate, so it is tagged pik_rate_pct rather than all_in_rate_pct, although it is in effect the all-in rate on those rows.
